name: gibbering mouther
desc: Gibbering Mouther is a CR 2 aberration.

actions.name: aberrant ground
actions.desc: The ground in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=zVznqPXgYjETqpQz]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name]]{monster} is &Reference[Difficult Terrain].

actions.name: gibbering
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} babbles incoherently while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=PyGOI84k0PPYrru8]], any [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=PyGOI84k0PPYrru8]] that starts its turn within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=PyGOI84k0PPYrru8]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls [[/r 1d8]] to determine what it does during the current turn: 1–4. The target does nothing. 5–6. The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. 7–8. The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack. Its body is then absorbed into the [[lookup @name]]{monster}, leaving only equipment behind.

actions.name: blinding spittle
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=JfU8KFZkAJxWtrhk]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=JfU8KFZkAJxWtrhk]]-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within [[lookup @range.value activity=JfU8KFZkAJxWtrhk]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
